positions.title: Up to two Full Professorships (W3) in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
positions.description: The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, through the Department of Computer Science, at the University of Bonn invites applications for up to two tenured and excellently equipped Full Professorships (W3) in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to be filled as soon as possible as strategic flagship positions within the Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Trustworthy Large Language Models
positions.description: The Lamarr Fellow project of Prof. Milica Gašić, Trustworthy Integration of Large Language Models in Human-Computer Interactive Systems, explores how we can harness the capabilities of large language models while ensuring that their use remains reliable and safe. The position is full-time with a competitive salary (EG 13 TV-L), offering the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research on trustworthy AI and human-computer interaction.
